feature_contract.goal: Keep game primitive workload and routing telemetry coherent within each DX9Ex physical Draw, and remove the second cross-translation-unit telemetry-enable query from the R33 dispatch hot path for all four primitive APIs.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R33 game Draw telemetry dispatch, not visual stereo transforms, device loss, FFB, original game hooks or any DX11/DXVK/localization source.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: The 2026-10-14 Quest3 frame capture reported up to 3298 draws per frame and 11.876ms game render p95. Source shows one R33TelemetryEnabled() query at each primitive entry and a second unconditional query in R33Dispatch for the same physical draw; this reduces repeated cross-TU state reads without claiming measured FPS improvement.
trace_stages: The original OutRun D3D9 draw reaches one of the four R33 interceptors.
R32 workload observer counts primitive classes only when telemetry is enabled before the draw.
R33 dispatch previously rereads the same enable state before recording HUD/world/legacy route statistics; both eyes reuse existing draw routing and fallback.
subcomponents: Snapshot telemetry enable at four physical Draw entrypoints and use it for the workload counter without touching D3D9 draw decisions.
Pass that draw-scoped publication through R33Dispatch and preserve fallback/recording, per-eye and Present reset routing.
Strengthen the exact-SHA existing R33 telemetry source/mutation verifier to reject stale or forced-false dispatch counters.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exactly one telemetry-enabled publication per original Draw and the same indexed/UP classification across four APIs.
Use the same snapshot at dispatch without changing StateBlock recording, mono/aux fallback, stereo draw calls or disabled-telemetry no-observer behavior.
Run existing negative mutations plus GitHub exact SHA DX9Ex Active Win32 game/host/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R33 DrawPrimitive, DrawIndexedPrimitive and UP hooks read R33TelemetryEnabled before workload observation; R33Dispatch rereads it for a second R32ReviewTelemetryEnabled call.
diagnosis.root_cause: Two cross-TU diagnostic enable queries per eligible physical Draw; a mid-draw toggle can also make workload and route counter decisions disagree.
source_trace: D3D9 physical game DrawPrimitive/Indexed/UP hooks in R33.
R32 workload classification with R29 effect snapshot used for sand/alpha-like diagnostics.
R33 route classification and HUD/world/fallback counters share the same Draw and do not change per-eye render state.
alternatives_rejected: Never cache telemetry across frames or Reset because live diagnostic toggles must remain responsive.
Do not change the existing stereo routing, right-eye projection, HUD scaling or protected SkyGlow.
Do not skip R32 workload observer or query once per Present because different physical Draws may use different diagnostic settings.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Updated existing CI verifier to enforce one entry sampling and dispatch propagation with destructive per-API mutations; exact GitHub gates pending.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Thread the existing entry telemetry boolean through the four R33Dispatch calls rather than making a second cross-TU query.
